title: Career Roadmap: Maritime Logistics Executive
summary: A Maritime Logistics Executive coordinates the movement of cargo through ports, shipping lines, freight forwarders, terminals, and inland transport networks. The role involves shipment documentation, cargo tracking, vessel schedules, customs coordination, and communication with shipping agents and customers.

facts.Current degree: B.Sc. in Maritime Science / Merchant Navy-related studies

blocks.text: For students interested in maritime operations but also drawn to logistics, coordination, and business processes, this can be a route into the commercial side of the shipping industry. A seagoing Merchant Navy qualification is not automatically required for shore-based maritime logistics roles.
Recommended education
B.Sc. Maritime Science, a relevant maritime degree, or a logistics, shipping, supply-chain, or transport-related qualification. Verify the eligibility requirements of individual employers.
Core focus
Shipping operations, cargo documentation, freight coordination, port processes, shipment tracking, and supply-chain management.
Potential workplaces
Shipping lines, freight forwarders, port operators, container terminals, customs brokers, logistics companies, and import-export businesses.
Key responsibilities

items.text: Coordinate import and export shipments with shipping lines, agents, and freight forwarders.
Track cargo movements, vessel schedules, estimated arrival times, and delivery milestones.
Prepare or check shipping documents such as bills of lading, packing lists, and commercial invoices.
Coordinate with customs brokers and relevant authorities for clearance requirements.
Monitor container availability, detention, demurrage, and shipment delays.
Communicate status updates to customers, suppliers, and operations teams.
Maintain shipment records, cost sheets, and logistics reports.
Help resolve documentation discrepancies and cargo-delivery issues.

blocks.text: Responsibilities vary by employer. Customs declarations and regulated activities may need to be handled by appropriately authorised personnel.

This plan assumes a three-year B.Sc. programme. Maritime Science programmes can have different durations and professional requirements, so follow your university's curriculum and verify whether the programme is designed for seagoing officer training or shore-based maritime careers.
Year 1 — Maritime and logistics foundations
Foundation

items.text: Learn shipping terminology, maritime geography, ports, and international trade basics.
Understand vessel types, cargo types, containers, and shipping routes.
Develop Excel, business communication, and report-writing skills.
Study introductory supply-chain management and transport systems.

blocks.label: Target outcome
blocks.text: Explain how cargo moves from an exporter to an overseas customer.
Year 2 — Shipping operations and documentation
Technical development

items.text: Learn bills of lading, shipping instructions, packing lists, and commercial invoices.
Study Incoterms, freight rates, container operations, and cargo handling.
Understand customs-clearance workflows and import-export documentation.
Practise shipment tracking, logistics cost calculations, and Excel reporting.
Explore maritime regulations and cargo safety relevant to shore-based work.

blocks.label: Target outcome
blocks.text: Prepare a simulated shipment file and track a shipment through key milestones.
Year 3 — Industry exposure and job readiness
Career preparation

items.text: Study international logistics, freight forwarding, port operations, and supply-chain performance.
Learn shipment exception management, customer service, and operational reporting.
Complete a logistics case study or port-and-shipping process project.
Seek internships with shipping lines, logistics providers, freight forwarders, or terminals.
Prepare a portfolio with sample documentation, tracking reports, and cost analyses.

blocks.label: Target outcome
blocks.text: Apply for Maritime Logistics Executive, Shipping Operations Assistant, or Freight Operations Coordinator roles.

blocks.label: Important qualification distinction
blocks.text: If your B.Sc. is specifically a pre-sea Maritime Science programme, check whether it is approved by India's Directorate General of Shipping (DGS), and understand its medical, training, and certification requirements. A shore-based logistics career generally follows a different path from becoming a deck officer at sea.

blocks.text: Create realistic, clearly labelled simulations rather than using confidential shipment records.

blocks.label: Project 1
blocks.text: Import-export documentation file
Build a sample shipment file for a fictional exporter, including a commercial invoice, packing list, shipping instructions, and a sample bill of lading layout.

blocks.label: Deliverables
blocks.text: document checklist, sample files, and discrepancy review.

blocks.label: Project 2
blocks.text: Shipment tracking dashboard
Create an Excel dashboard for 20 fictional shipments showing origin, destination, vessel, estimated arrival, shipment status, and delay alerts.

blocks.label: Deliverables
blocks.text: interactive tracker, status summary, and exception report.

blocks.label: Project 3
blocks.text: Freight cost comparison
Compare hypothetical shipping quotes, including ocean freight, handling, documentation charges, inland transport, and applicable surcharges.

blocks.label: Deliverables
blocks.text: comparison spreadsheet, assumptions, and a recommended option.

blocks.label: Project 4
blocks.text: Shipment delay and exception management
Simulate a vessel delay or missing-document scenario and prepare an escalation plan covering customer communication, revised milestones, and follow-up actions.

blocks.label: Deliverables
blocks.text: incident log, stakeholder email, revised timeline, and root-cause summary.

items.text: Incoterms 2020 fundamentals.
Freight forwarding and shipping documentation.

blocks.text: Choose certifications based on employer requirements. A short course does not replace any statutory qualification required for regulated maritime duties.
Depending on your career direction, consider:

items.text: MBA in Logistics and Supply Chain Management: For logistics operations, planning, and management.
M.Sc. Maritime Studies or Shipping Management: For advanced maritime industry knowledge, subject to programme eligibility.
Postgraduate Diploma in Shipping and Logistics: For specialised commercial shipping knowledge.

blocks.label: MBA in International Business
blocks.text: For trade operations, global logistics, and import-export management.
Further education is not always necessary for entry-level logistics positions; practical documentation skills and relevant internship experience can be more immediately useful.

blocks.label: Stage 1
blocks.text: Shipping Documentation / Logistics Assistant
Learn shipment records, documentation, tracking, and coordination.

blocks.label: Stage 2
blocks.text: Maritime Logistics Executive
Manage shipment milestones, customer updates, freight coordination, and exceptions.

blocks.label: Stage 3
blocks.text: Senior Logistics Executive / Operations Supervisor
Oversee complex shipments, service quality, costs, and operational teams.

blocks.label: Stage 4
blocks.text: Logistics Manager / Shipping Operations Manager
Lead teams, manage customer accounts, improve processes, and oversee operational performance.
Progression depends on experience, employer structure, commercial knowledge, and demonstrated operational performance.

blocks.label: Port automation
blocks.text: Digital terminal systems and automated cargo handling.

blocks.label: Logistics analytics

blocks.label: Sustainable shipping
blocks.text: Alternative fuels, emissions reporting, and maritime decarbonisation.

blocks.label: AI-assisted logistics
blocks.text: Forecasting delays, improving route planning, and automating document checks.

Recommended target profile
By graduation, aim to have:

items.text: A solid understanding of shipping operations and international trade.
Practical knowledge of shipping documentation and Incoterms.
Strong Excel skills and experience creating shipment trackers.
Three or four documented logistics projects.
An internship or relevant practical exposure to shipping or freight operations.

blocks.label: Best initial target
blocks.text: Maritime Logistics Executive, Shipping Operations Assistant, or Freight Forwarding Executive. Build your career through documentation accuracy, customer coordination, shipment tracking, and cost control before progressing into logistics management or specialised shipping operations.
